system.description: Ask the GM a question you want answered. The GM sets a difficulty for the answer—the more obscure the answer, the more difficult the task. If you succeed at an Intellect task against this difficulty, you get a short answer to the question. If you fail, you take 4 Intellect damage from digital feedback. Action.
